provenance: Explicit user selections on 26 October 2026, including Magic Coat clarification: until the user next acts. These are private-group interpretations, not edits to source cards.

abilities.Torrent: Group rule: behave like Blaze, Overgrow and Swarm: Water accuracy/damage ignore pain; add two Water damage dice at half HP or less. Shared attacks retain frozen inputs.
abilities.Rivalry: Group rule: against a foe, same gender grants +1 Strength and opposite gender -1. Unknown/genderless cases are neutral; actual individual gender remains an explicit input.
abilities.Mycelium Might: Group rule: all Support moves have Never Miss and Late Reaction 1, overriding printed Reaction. A selected Choice Scarf overrides Late Reaction.

moves.Magic Coat: Group rule: lasts until the user takes its next action, including reactions. Foe actions and round changes do not consume it.
moves.Bide: Group rule: accumulate the user damage over the existing two-hit preparation, then hit the last Pokemon to attack the user. Later misses update the attacker, without adding damage.
moves.Mirror Coat: Source-defined correction: Late Reaction 5, only as a response to a Special move attacking the user. Target that attacker; roll its exact incoming damage pool plus two dice, ignoring defenses. Uses the shared Evasion/reaction slot; no stored coat or later reuse.

items.Max Revive: Group rule: full revival is not limited by the shared three-HP round cap. Existing fainting eligibility and healing blocks remain.
items.Revival Herb: Group rule: full revival is not limited by the shared three-HP round cap. Herbal acceptance/Gluttony and fainting eligibility remain.
items.Ring Target: Group rule: remove the holder type and ability immunities, including unique ability immunities. Does not erase other ability benefits or item/field protection; Klutz and Magic Room still suppress the item.
items.Choice Scarf: Group rule: the selected move gains Reaction 5 overriding Late Reaction, including Mycelium Might; other printed Choice effects are unchanged.
